phases.name: Integration: Browser verification and end-to-end check
phases.description: Serve the app and verify the full infinite scroll flow works correctly: sentinel triggers loadPage() on scroll, spinner appears/disappears correctly, loadMoreBtn is gone from DOM, recorder-bar frosted glass does not obscure any UI, no JS errors.

subtasks.description:
Serve the app (npx serve public -p 5000 OR firebase emulators:start) and perform the following browser checks:
1. Open DevTools Elements: verify NO #loadMoreBtn element; verify #loadMoreSentinel exists after #historyList
2. Open DevTools Console: verify zero JavaScript errors on page load
3. If >20 transcriptions available: scroll to bottom → verify next page loads automatically without any button click
4. During load: verify sentinel briefly shows a spinning circle (sentinel-spinner)
5. After last page loads: verify sentinel is empty, no spinner, no button
6. Search: type in search box → verify filtering still works
7. Mobile (375px viewport): verify recorder-bar frosted glass does not cover the sentinel
8. Verify copy, edit, delete buttons still work on cards
